source: BDS 1.26.51: a flat world saved by BDS (overworld setups, generated nether and End), then edited with /setblock and /fill; the edited chunks were unloaded (ticking areas removed) so BDS saved them through its unload path
states: cell form name|key=<b|i|s>value,... (keys sorted), indexed by the writes and builds
before: BDS record before the edits (hex), or before_build: [x, y, z, state] placements into an air section that rebuild it, with its before_sha256; null when the section had no record
writes: [x, y, z, state, liquid state or -1] in order (both layers of one cell, as /setblock left them); {"fill": [state, liquid]} writes every cell of the section
after: SHA-256 and length of the record BDS saved when the chunk unloaded; null when BDS deleted it
